verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a REST API and TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The llms.txt probe is a docs index for LLMs, not an API specification, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
